ways.label: Holdsworth to Kaitoke

start.name: Holdsworth car park
start.quote: The track begins at the Holdsworth car park at the end of Holdsworth Road.

end.name: Kaitoke road end carpark
end.quote: the Kaitoke road end carpark, located along Kiwi Ranch Road

via.name: Holdsworth Lodge
via.quote: From Holdsworth Lodge, cross the bridge

via.name: Gentle Annie Track

via.name: Totara Creek Track

via.name: Totara Flats Hut

via.name: Cone Saddle Track

via.name: Clem Creek

via.name: Cone Hut

evidence: The track begins at the Holdsworth car park at the end of Holdsworth Road.
It climbs to Puffer Saddle and down to the Kaitoke road end carpark, located along Kiwi Ranch Road.

not_on_route.name: Powell Hut
not_on_route.quote: Turn left at the signpost onto the track to Powell Hut

doubts: Start: Holdsworth car park has no feature (F1 is Lower Waiohine Track at Waiohine Gorge Road, not the same place), so null. The Powell Hut quote is from the same sentence, which says to turn left onto the track to Powell Hut and climb the Gentle Annie track; the walk is taken to go up the Gentle Annie track towards Mountain House Shelter rather than to Powell Hut, so Powell Hut is not on route (ref left null). Waiohine River has no name entry (peak Waiohine only) so it is not a via. The page also mentions an all-weather track round a slip below Totara Flats; not recorded as a way or exit since no start or end is given.
